title: It's a beautiful throw but...
text: It's a beautiful throw but.... ...the colors that are shown aren't true IRL. I got the green which had shown more of a lighter, sage green but when it came it was a darker Kelly green. Still, it's a beautiful throw it was just too dark for what I bought it for. If there were more color options I'd consider getting another color for myself as it was a nice throw.
